# Agent Factory Lab

> Open research lab testing techniques to make AI coding agents faster, cheaper, and more reliable.

This site documents research findings and experiment results for improving two AI coding agents: Gwaihir (orchestrator for herdr, a multi-agent coding tool) and Landroval (orchestrator for Rex, a coding factory).

## Key Results

- Batched tool calls: 94.5% token reduction (real measurement via tiktoken)
- Prompt caching: 72.3% cost savings over 20-turn session (real token counts)
- Parallel pane execution: 1.83x speedup (real tmux measurement)
- Writer/reviewer pipeline: +15pp fix rate, -42% defect escapes (Monte Carlo simulation)
- Cheap model routing: 20.9% cost savings (estimated from public pricing)
- SuperPlane backlog-to-ship: state machine with risk-gated auto-merge (simulated)
